query: Consider the following context: Constituent phases and their corresponding phase transformations are important in developing alloys. In that context, which method can be used for control of phase evolution in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni HEAs, and why?

decision.trend: Research has been focused on developing new methods for controlling phase evolution in high-entropy alloys (HEAs), including computational screening, stepwise thermo-mechanical processes, and high-pressure high-temperature treatment. These methods have shown promise in achieving ultrahigh strength and ductility in HEAs.
decision.unsolved: The lack of a suitable method for controlling phase evolution in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni HEAs remains a significant challenge. Existing methods have limitations, and further research is needed to develop a reliable and efficient approach.
decision.why: Given the complexity of phase evolution in HEAs, a machine learning-based approach could provide a powerful tool for predicting and controlling phase evolution. This method could leverage existing computational screening methods and incorporate experimental data to develop a more accurate and efficient model for phase evolution control.
